newsitem.title: UK: Bridon sets US twine jv with Universal Co-op.
newsitem.headline: Bridon sets US twine jv with Universal Co-op.

text.p: British industrial manufacturer Bridon plc said on Friday it had formed a joint venture to produce polypropylene twine with Universal Cooperatives Inc of Minnesota into which it will contribute its existing Bridon Cordage Inc business.

The venture wil be 50 percent owned by each of the partners, and is intended to expand the opportunities for the business 'by creating a broader product line and expanding geographic coverage from a stronger customer base', the company said in a statement.
The British firm said it would contribute assets amounting to $5.5 million, while UCI will contribute $0.8 million in fixed assets and the balance of $4.7 million in cash.
The new company will buy the working capital of Bridon Cordage Inc for some $5.4 million, resulting in a corresponding reduction in Bridon's borrowings, it added.
